name: Cloud Migration
hook: You're outgrowing where you're hosted now, and need to move onto AWS without losing data or downtime along the way.
includes: Live database migration with AWS DMS
Re-platforming onto managed services (RDS, ElastiCache, S3, CloudFront)

name: Infrastructure Cost Management
hook: Your AWS bill is higher than it should be, or you simply don't have visibility into where the money's going.
includes: Ongoing cost monitoring so it doesn't creep back up

name: Security Tightening
hook: You need to know where the real gaps are before a client, auditor, or attacker finds them for you.

name: AI/ML Development
hook: You want to ship AI features that hold up in production, not just in a demo.
includes: Multi-provider model abstraction (Bedrock, OpenAI, and others)
Production deployment, not just a notebook

name: Custom Cloud Solutions
hook: You need something built end-to-end for your infrastructure, not off-the-shelf.
includes: Built on infrastructure that scales with you

name: Observability & Alerting
hook: You have to make critical business decisions without the metrics to back them up.
includes: Metrics and dashboards for what actually matters
Alerting that reaches you before your users notice
Distributed tracing for real production debugging

name: Infrastructure Management
hook: Your infrastructure needs ongoing maintenance, and you or your team are stretched too thin to keep up with it.
includes: Proactive scaling before it becomes a problem
